summary: Ares Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $100 million subscription agreement with an affiliate, Perigee SPV, for the sale of Class B common shares at the April 2026 NAV per share of Class I-PR common stock. The sponsor and an institutional investor capitalized the purchase. The shares are subject to a three-year lock-up, after which Perigee may redeem via the share redemption program, with subordinate priority to other common stockholders. This private placement bolsters capital but does not constitute a tender or buyback. The filing is classified as a capital return special situation due to the structured equity issuance with redemption features.
